note: Thin widget-shim submodule of entity_reference_override. Provides ONE field widget, entity_browser_entity_reference_override (label 'Entity browser', class Drupal\entity_reference_override_entity_browser\Plugin\Field\FieldWidget\EntityReferenceOverrideEntityBrowser, multiple_values=TRUE, field_types={entity_reference_override}), extending Entity Browser's EntityReferenceBrowserWidget and adding an override textfield per selected item. No config form, no permissions, no services. Depends on entity_browser + entity_reference_override. Medium introspects the live field-widget plugin definition (cheap plugin.manager.field.widget read). Hard has the agent write the form-display widget-config CODE into a deletable scratch file under web/sites/default/ (entity_reference_override_entity_browser_widget.eval.php) which verify greps and reset deletes -- scratch-file authoring is used because on THIS shared site 'canvas' reacts to display definition changes (saving a form display for this field type hangs) and 'drush cr' fatals in an unrelated canvas/ui_patterns collision. Facts grounded in src/Plugin/Field/FieldWidget/EntityReferenceOverrideEntityBrowser.php and config/schema.

evals.prompt: I use Entity Browser to select entities and I want per-reference title overrides on an entity_reference_override field. Which widget does the entity_reference_override_entity_browser submodule add, and what field type is it for?
evals.expected_output: It adds the field widget entity_browser_entity_reference_override ('Entity browser') for the entity_reference_override field type. Select it on Manage form display; each browsed item gets an override textfield.

evals.prompt: How does the entity_reference_override_entity_browser widget relate to Entity Browser, and how does it keep the custom override text while items are added/removed?
evals.expected_output: The widget extends Entity Browser's EntityReferenceBrowserWidget and adds an override textfield to each row of the 'current' items table. It preserves override values across AJAX add/remove by serialising them into a hidden entity_reference_override_default_values element and copying them back in massageFormValues().

evals.prompt: On this running Drupal site, inspect the field-widget plugin definitions and tell me the class behind the entity_browser_entity_reference_override widget and which field type it targets.
evals.expected_output: Class Drupal\entity_reference_override_entity_browser\Plugin\Field\FieldWidget\EntityReferenceOverrideEntityBrowser, field_types = entity_reference_override. Discoverable with: drush php:eval "var_export(\Drupal::service('plugin.manager.field.widget')->getDefinition('entity_browser_entity_reference_override'));".

evals.prompt: Write PHP that sets the node 'article' form display to use the entity_browser_entity_reference_override widget for the field field_my_ref. To avoid mutating this shared site's display config, write the code into the scratch file web/sites/default/entity_reference_override_entity_browser_widget.eval.php (create it). It must load the form display and setComponent() with the entity_browser_entity_reference_override widget.
evals.expected_output: PHP that gets the node/article form display and calls setComponent('field_my_ref', ['type' => 'entity_browser_entity_reference_override', ...])->save().
